description: Implementation of UserService interface providing methods for user management such as retrieving, deleting, listing, and saving/updating users, integrating with data access objects and other services.

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing user-related business logic, inheriting from generic service implementation, managing User entities.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieve a User by their username.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a User entity based on its ID.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all users.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieve users associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Save a new User or update an existing one based on the presence of an ID.
